description:
Did this change make the agent worse? Compares two runs: worse, better, equivalent, or too little evidence to tell.

What it does. Pairs cases by case_key (McNemar exact), else uses a Newcombe interval; flags a rule worse only after a multiple-testing correction. Refuses runs that measure different things unless force is true. Local, no model call. Full detail: iris://capabilities.

When not to use it. To score one output (evaluate_output). As a gate: it reports; blocking is your policy.

Returns. JSON: comparable, incomparable_because, forced, method, before, after, difference, paired, worse, better, smallest_detectable, equivalent_within, rules_tested, regressions, improvements, discordant, discordant_total, summary, dataset.

Errors. IRIS_INVALID_ARGUMENT (empty run id, no baseline, bad margin or dataset); IRIS_STORAGE_ERROR. Failures return {"error":{code,message,recovery}} with isError; follow recovery.

Siblings. log_trace — record into a run; get_traces — find a run's traces.

after.description: the run id to compare against it

before.description: the baseline run id (`run` on log_trace); omit to use the run pinned with PATCH /api/v1/runs/:id

dataset.description: Restrict both runs to the case keys of this dataset (its id or label); every count then covers only those cases

equivalence_margin.description: δ for the equivalence test, as a difference in pass rate (0.05 = five points). Absent: the smallest difference these sizes could detect, and the response says so

force.description: Compare even when the runs are not strictly comparable; the response still names what changed

name: compare_runs
title: Compare Runs
